name: selfgrow
description: A local-first Obsidian plugin for capturing and reviewing knowledge material.

scripts.format: prettier --write src tests package.json manifest.json versions.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs eslint.config.mts README.md styles.css
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests package.json manifest.json versions.json tsconfig.json esbuild.config.mjs eslint.config.mts README.md styles.css
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
